span.p:
MEMORY
a lane of numbered bytes
addr of element i = base + i x sizeof(T)

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CONTIGUOUS LAYOUT
array: stride = sizeof(T), O(1) index, capacity fixed at compile time

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SCATTERED LAYOUT
node = data + pointer, one hop per element, grows until the allocator refuses

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
list types
singly, doubly, circular
insert or delete in O(1) when the predecessor is held

div.style: color: rgb(74, 36, 21) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: how many ends can you touch?

div.style: color: rgb(43, 63, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STACK ADT
one end only, LIFO
push and pop are both O(1)

div.style: color: rgb(43, 63, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
QUEUE ADT
two ends, FIFO
enqueue at the rear, dequeue at the front, circular queue wraps

div.style: color: rgb(43, 63, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RECURSION
the call stack IS a stack of frames
48 bytes per frame, measured on this machine

div.style: color: rgb(43, 63, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
factorial, fibonacci, Towers of Hanoi
recursion depth = the memory you spend
